extraction.document_summary: FWD MultiCover CI is a critical illness protection plan that provides multiple payouts and continued coverage beyond the first critical illness claim. It offers a “Critical Illness Benefit” with stage-based payouts (including early-/intermediate-stage and late-stage diagnoses) and continued protection for recurrence, with a “Critical Illness Booster Benefit” and limits on how much can be claimed cumulatively (including a shared 600% claim limit). For late-stage cases, policyholders may also exercise an “Accelerated Care Option” (75% of the Sum Insured) when conditions are met; this option can be exercised only once and is irreversible, and exercising it causes the Critical Illness Booster Benefit to cease. The plan also includes ICU benefits (including an additional Severe Intensive Care Unit Benefit for more severe ICU admissions) with a per-person cap of S$25,000. It further pays a lump-sum Death Benefit of S$5,000 if death occurs while the policy is in force.
quality_notes: Most key payout mechanics, key limits, waiting periods, and benefit cessation conditions are stated in the brochure.
Specific entry ages, underwriting approach details, and the full list of covered conditions/definitions are not provided in this excerpt (only referenced as available in the Policy Contract).
The document contains numeric examples, but those are not treated as guaranteed plan parameters beyond the explicitly stated benefit mechanics and limits.

policies.quick_summary: Multi-payout critical illness coverage with continued protection after the first claim, including an additional Booster Benefit and an Accelerated Care Option for certain first late-stage diagnoses, plus ICU benefits and a S$5,000 lump-sum Death Benefit while the policy is in force; multiple-claim limits and benefit cessation rules apply (including shared 600% claim limit). The plan is underwritten by FWD Singapore Pte. Ltd. and is subject to pre-existing conditions/exclusions and other benefit-specific terms in the Policy Contract (not provided in full here). See quoted evidence for limits and cessation triggers.
coverage_scope: Early-, intermediate-, and late-stage specified critical illnesses
Recurrent critical illness (after first claim, subject to limits/terms)
Intensive Care Unit (ICU) admission benefit for invasive life support conditions
Severe ICU admission benefit (more severe cases) subject to deductions from the same shared 600% claim limit
Special Benefit for 22 covered special conditions
Juvenile Benefit for 17 covered juvenile conditions (below attained age 18)
Lump-sum Death Benefit of S$5,000 while policy is in force
policies.eligibility_notes: Coverage terms are stated as “from 5 years up to age 100”. Juvenile Benefit applies for Person Insured below attained age 18.
policies.coverage_term_description: Flexible coverage terms from 5 years up to age 100.
policy_termination_events: Accelerated Care Option exercised causes Critical Illness Booster Benefit to cease (and Booster ceases on other earlier events).
Intensive Care Unit Benefit ceases when Person Insured turns age 85 or when a claim under this benefit has been made.
Severe Intensive Care Unit Benefit ceases when Person Insured turns age 85, when a claim under this benefit has been made, or when the Critical Illness Benefit has ceased.
Special Benefit and Juvenile Benefit cease based on reaching sixth claim threshold or age limits (Special Benefit: age 85; Juvenile Benefit: age 18).
important_caveats: Maximum cumulative claim limits apply and not all benefits remain payable up to 900%; payouts may be reduced based on earlier claims and certain benefits have earlier limits and may cease upon reaching defined cumulative claim thresholds.
Critical Illness Booster Benefit cessation is tied to cumulative payout and/or the Accelerated Care Option exercise.
ICU admission must be for Necessary Medical Treatment; Severe ICU and ICU benefits are subject to caps/claim limits.
ICU-related benefits are payable once each (per stated benefit).
Claims under Intensive Care Unit Benefit and Severe Intensive Care Unit Benefit have interaction with the shared 600% claim limit.
